item.title: Self-Hosted Newsroom Stack in 2026: Superdesk vs Wagtail vs Coral Compared
item.description: Enterprise publishing platforms quote six figures per year for a mid-size newsroom, which is why news organisations with shrinking budgets keep rebuilding their stack out of open-source parts. The catch is that “newsroom software” is not one product — it is three problems: an editing and production workflow, a content management system that renders the site, and an audience engagement layer that keeps readers arguing productively in the comments.
